entities.name: P5CS (P54886)
observations: Delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate synthase (P5CS/ALDH18A1) is a 768-aa query with 100% full-query match to reviewed mouse Q9Z110 and 95.7% identity to reviewed human P54886.
Bifunctional enzyme catalyzes glutamate phosphorylation to glutamyl-5-phosphate and NADP+-dependent reduction to glutamate 5-semialdehyde, supporting proline, ornithine, and arginine biosynthesis.
Pfam scans detect AA_kinase PF00696 at residues 71–329 and Aldedh PF00171 at 364–625.
Close human/mouse homolog annotations place P5CS in the mitochondrial matrix and report homo-oligomerization; these are homolog-based annotations for the query.
Predicted sequence properties: 768 aa; mass ~84.15 kDa; theoretical pI ~7.39.
